notes:
• Chat during matches with opponents who also use MatchDesk Scout.
• App performance improvements.
• Automatic cleanup of temporary files and other files the app no longer uses.
• Analyze your play style in the My Game tab, with stats for passing, shooting, defending, and dribbling.
• New interface languages.
• When you face an opponent again, see the last score and your win, draw, and loss record if previous matches are available. You can also save a private note about the opponent.
• Pro also shows the ping and region from your last connection with that opponent, when available.
• When you match with a marked opponent again, choose between an alert or an alert with an attempt to block the connection.

android.notes:
Português

Novidades do MatchDesk Mobile 3.0

• Visual renovado com a nova identidade verde.
• Bordas do painel de ping com cores diferentes para conexões LAN, P2P e por servidor.
• Melhorias na reconexão e na recuperação do monitor e dos filtros.

English

What's new in MatchDesk Mobile 3.0

• A refreshed design with the new green identity.
• Ping panel borders use different colors for LAN, P2P and server connections.
• Improvements to reconnection and recovery of monitoring and filters.
